text.tspan: Global Accelerator parts: listener → endpoint groups (one per Region) → endpoints
Healthy → gets new connections (closest Region, by weight)
Traffic dial 0-100%: share of this Region's traffic
Unhealthy → new connections go to the next Region
Failover in under 1 minute (FAQ), no DNS change, so no
client DNS cache problem. Existing connections are
not moved. All unhealthy → it fails open (routes to all).
GA checks EC2 / Elastic IP endpoints itself (settings in GA).
For ALB / NLB it uses the load balancer's own health checks
(set in the ELB console). Great for disaster recovery.
Supported: ALB, EC2, NLB with security groups.
Not supported: Elastic IP endpoints, NLB without SG.
Dual-stack accelerators need it on every endpoint.
• Only 2 IPs for clients to allowlist (firewalls, corporate proxies) · AWS Shield DDoS protection · endpoints can stay internal.
• Custom routing accelerator: maps each user to one specific EC2 instance + port in VPC subnets (game sessions); no health checks or failover.
